files.en: If the wind blows, trees move.
If you heat ice, it melts.
If you press the green button, the light turns on.
If water boils, it becomes steam.
If plants get no water, they die.
If you mix blue and yellow, you get green.
If metal gets hot enough, it glows.
If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home.
If you call me tonight, I will answer.
If she misses the train, she will take a taxi.
If we finish early, we will watch a movie.
If he loses his key, he will wait outside.
If they win the match, they will celebrate at school.
If I see Lucy at the mall, I will say hello.
If the shop closes now, we will come back next week.
